scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c auto "npm run dev -w @paralleax/api" "npm run dev -w @paralleax/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @paralleax/shared && npm run build -w @paralleax/api && npm run build -w @paralleax/web
scripts.test: npm run test:operations && npm run test -w @paralleax/shared && npm run test -w @paralleax/api && npm run test -w @paralleax/web
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage -w @paralleax/shared && npm run coverage -w @paralleax/api && npm run coverage -w @paralleax/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint:baseline && node scripts/quality/eslint.mjs && npm run lint:css && npm run lint:duplicates
scripts.lint:baseline:prune: node scripts/quality/eslint.mjs --prune-suppressions && node scripts/quality/css-baseline.mjs --prune && depcruise apps/web/src apps/api/src packages/shared/src --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --baseline --baseline-mode shrink-only && node scripts/quality/duplicates.mjs --prune && npm run lint:architecture
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @paralleax/shared && npm run typecheck -w @paralleax/api && npm run typecheck -w @paralleax/web
